title: Payment Arrangements — Schedule of Minimum Installments, Rounding Units and Down Payments
content:
The amounts below are the product figures of Payment Arrangements that govern the size of installments: the smallest regular installment on each frequency, the smallest regular installment expressed in monthly-equivalent terms as a percentage of the plan total, the unit to which regular installments are rounded up (the final installment absorbing the difference), and the down payment each type requires.

## Minimum regular installment

| Arrangement type | Weekly (USD) | Biweekly (USD) | Monthly (USD) | Monthly-equivalent minimum (% of plan total) | Rounding unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.0 | 0.01 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 15.0 | 1.00 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 0.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 8.0 | 1.00 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 0.00 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 4.0 | 1.00 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 2.0 | 1.00 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 1.0 | 1.00 |

A minimum of 0.00 appears where the type does not offer that frequency.

## Down payment

| Arrangement type | Down payment required (% of plan total) | Falls due within (calendar days after creation) |
|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 0.0 | 0 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 0.0 | 0 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 5.0 | 7 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 10.0 | 7 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 10.0 | 7 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 0.0 | 0 |

A required percentage of 0.0 means the type takes no down payment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan totals)

- An Extended Installment Plan with a plan total of 4000.00 requires a down payment of at least 10.0 percent of 4000.00, that is 400.00, falling due within 7 calendar days after creation.
- On a Long-Term Installment Plan with a plan total of 12000.00, the monthly-equivalent minimum is 2.0 percent of 12000.00, that is 240.00; the frequency minimum of 100.00 is also respected.
- Rounding up to 1.00 turns a computed regular installment of 211.37 into 212.00; on the Promise-to-Pay Arrangement, whose unit is 0.01, the same figure stays 211.37.
